$comment: What a production dependency may be licensed under. Read by the shared licence-check action, which checks every package the lockfile installs under `npm ci --omit=dev`. `licences` are SPDX identifiers accepted wherever they appear; an `OR` expression passes when any branch is here, an `AND` only when every part is. `packages` is for the rest: one entry per package, pinned to the versions somebody actually read, with the licence that reading found and why it is acceptable. A bump that moves past a pinned version fails until the new version is read too.
